TRAINING AND SELECTION, provider statement: the public JevBench v1.4/v1.5 items were used as a validation set (recipe and checkpoint choice, serving parameters), not as training data, and the model card says no benchmark test items were used for training; the public set is therefore treated as seen during selection and the normal public-versus-sealed gap rule applies to this row. Provider statements are not independently verified.
